title: Perimenopause
content: Perimenopause means 'around menopause' and refers to the time during which a woman's body makes the natural transition to menopause. It can start in a woman's 40s or even late 30s. Symptoms include irregular periods (as ovulation becomes unpredictable), hot flashes, sleep problems, and mood changes. It lasts until menopause (defined as 12 consecutive months without a period).
